_comment: Copywriting for marketing screenshots, indexed by App Store locale (matching fastlane/metadata/<locale>/) then by screen name (the suffix after the device name in the raw fastlane snapshot filename, e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro Max-01Meetings.png' -> '01Meetings'). The caption leads with the search terms the listing targets (the same ones as that locale's name, subtitle and keywords), because Apple is reported to read caption text from screenshots and, indexed or not, it is the first thing a searcher reads. Every locale here is rendered: one with no raw captures of its own is rendered over render.js's --fallback-locale captures. 'default' is used by render.js when a captured locale has no entry here.
